mapper.select: with base_user as ( select u.id as user_id, case when u.account_type = 3 then coalesce(( select b.owner_user_id from sp.sp_subaccount_connector_binding b where b.subaccount_user_id = u.id and b.sync_status = 'SUCCESS' order by b.update_time desc, b.id desc limit 1 ), u.id) else u.id end as resolved_user_id from sp."user" u where u.id = #{userId} limit 1 ) select bu.user_id, bu.resolved_user_id, case when u.auth_type = 1 then ur.user_identity_code when u.auth_type = 2 then lo.legal_org_id when u.auth_type = 3 then op.operator_id else null end as user_identity_code, case when u.auth_type = 1 then ur.user_name when u.auth_type = 2 then lo.legal_org_name when u.auth_type = 3 then op.operator_name else null end as subject_name from base_user bu join sp."user" u on u.id = bu.resolved_user_id left join ( select uri.user_id, uri.user_identity_code, uri.user_name, row_number() over(partition by uri.user_id order by uri.create_time desc, uri.id desc) as rn from sp.user_real_auth_info uri ) ur on u.id = ur.user_id and ur.rn = 1 and u.auth_type = 1 left join ( select lai.user_id, lai.legal_org_id, lai.legal_org_name, row_number() over(partition by lai.user_id order by lai.create_time desc, lai.id desc) as rn from sp.legal_org_auth_info lai ) lo on u.id = lo.user_id and lo.rn = 1 and u.auth_type = 2 left join ( select loi.user_id, loi.operator_id, loi.operator_name, row_number() over(partition by loi.user_id order by loi.create_time desc, loi.id desc) as rn from sp.legal_org_operator_info loi ) op on u.id = op.user_id and op.rn = 1 and u.auth_type = 3 where u.auth_status = 1 limit 1
